english.title: Fail to allow constable reasonable facilities to examine firearm in transit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having the control or custody of

(A)_[a firearm,]_
(B)_[firearms,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE FIREARM / FIREARMS..), in the course of transit, failed on demand by a constable, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), to allow

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

all reasonable facilities for the examination and inspection thereof
english.legislation: Contrary to section 49(3) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
